sections.body:
Limitation: Paid pricing is per location — multi-site TCO stacks faster than per-user WFM; Free Basic is capped at 1 location and 10 employees; Payroll, tip manager, and hiring boosts are add-ons on every tier because it forces process changes or add-ons around Homebase when applicant tracking is the job.

sections.heading: Decision scenario and conclusion for Homebase
sections.body:

Setup requires a specialist owner when Paid pricing is per location — multi-site TCO stacks faster than per-user WFM collides with applicant tracking; SMB pilots can stay lighter if payroll processing (Basic, Essentials, Plus, All-in-One) is already on Essentials.
